MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #14
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is √36? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 7
   C. 18
   D. 6

2. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 45
   B. 36
   C. 30
   D. 18

3. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x + 2
   B. 12x + 2
   C. 6x
   D. 12x

4. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 25
   D. 1

5. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 43
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 1

6. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 1

7. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.6
   B. 19
   C. 25
   D. 19.7

8. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 12 cm³
   B. 18 cm³
   C. 9 cm³
   D. 27 cm³

9. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x < 5
   B. x ≥ 0 only
   C. x = 5
   D. x > 5

10. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27
   B. 27.6
   C. 27.7
   D. 33

11. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 37
   C. 2
   D. 1

12. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. 1/4
   C. Cannot tell
   D. They are equal

13. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 10 000 m²
   B. 100 000 m²
   C. 1000 m²
   D. 100 m²

14. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 37
   C. 31.7
   D. 31.6

15. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.6
   B. 15.7
   C. 15
   D. 21

16. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 22
   C. 14
   D. 28

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
